source: H. C. Agrippa, Three Books of Occult Philosophy II.37, English tr. J.F. (London 1651), public domain; text via esotericarchives.com/agrippa/agripp2c.htm (spelling as printed; some images abridged with ...)

decans.image: a black man, standing and cloathed in a white garment, girdled about, of a great body, with reddish eyes, and great strength, and like one that is angry
decans.signifies: boldness, fortitude, loftiness and shamelesness

decans.image: a woman, outwardly cloathed with a red garment, and under it a white, spreading abroad over her feet
decans.signifies: nobleness, height of a Kingdom, and greatness of dominion

decans.image: a white man, pale, with reddish hair, and cloathed with a red garment, who carrying on the one hand a golden Bracelet, and holding forth a wooden staff, is restless
decans.signifies: wit, meekness, joy and beauty

decans.image: a naked man, an Archer, Harvester or Husbandman, and goeth forth to sow, plough, build, people, and divide the earth
decans.signifies: sowing, ploughing, building, dividing the earth by geometry

decans.image: a naked man, holding in his hand a key
decans.signifies: power, nobility, and dominion over people

decans.image: a man in whose hand is a Serpent, and a dart
decans.signifies: necessity and profit, and also of misery & slavery

decans.image: a man in whose hand is a rod, and he is, as it were, serving another
decans.signifies: wisdom, and the knowledge of numbers and arts in which there is no profit

decans.image: a man in whose hand is a Pipe, and another being bowed down, digging the earth
decans.signifies: infamous and dishonest agility, as that of Jesters and Juglers; labours and painful searchings

decans.image: a man seeking for Arms, and a fool holding in the right hand a Bird, and in his left a pipe
decans.signifies: forgetfulness, wrath, boldness, jeasts, scurrilities, and unprofitable words

decans.image: a young Virgin, adorned with fine cloathes, and having a Crown on her head
decans.signifies: acuteness of senses, subtilty of wit, and the love of men

decans.image: a man cloathed in comely apparrel, or a man and woman sitting at the table and playing
decans.signifies: riches, mirth, gladness, and the love of women

decans.image: a man a Hunter with his lance and horne, bringing out dogs for to hunt
decans.signifies: the contention of men, the pursuing of those who fly, the hunting and possessing of things by arms and brawlings

decans.image: a man riding on a Lion
decans.signifies: boldness, violence, cruelty, wickedness, lust and labours to be sustained

decans.image: an image with hands lifted up, and a man on whose head is a Crown ... having in his right hand a Sword drawn out of the scabbard, & in his left a buckler
decans.signifies: hidden contentions, and unknown victories, base men, and the occasions of quarrels and battels

decans.image: a young man in whose hand is a Whip, and a man very sad, and of an ill aspect
decans.signifies: love and society, and the loss of ones right for avoiding strife

decans.image: a good maide, and a man casting seeds
decans.signifies: getting of wealth, ordering of diet, plowing, sowing, and peopling

decans.image: a black man cloathed with a skin, and a man having a bush of hair, holding a bag
decans.signifies: gain, scraping together of wealth and covetousness

decans.image: a white woman and deaf, or an old man leaning on a staff
decans.signifies: weakness, infirmity, loss of members, destruction of trees, and depopulation of lands

decans.image: an angry man, in whose hand is a Pipe, and the form of a man reading in a book
decans.signifies: justifying and helping the miserable and weak against the powerful and wicked

decans.image: two men furious and wrathful and a man in a comely garment, sitting in a chair
decans.signifies: indignation against the evil, and quietness and security of life with plenty of good things

decans.image: a violent man holding a bow, and before him a naked man, and also another man holding bread in one hand, and a cup of wine in the other
decans.signifies: wicked lusts, singings, sports and gluttony

decans.image: a woman of good face and habit, and two men striking her
decans.signifies: comliness, beauty, and for strifes, treacheries, deceits, detractations, and perditions

decans.image: a man naked, and a woman naked, and a man sitting on the earth, and before him two dogs biting one another
decans.signifies: impudence, deceit, and false dealing, and to lend mischief and strife amongst men

decans.image: a man bowed downward upon his knees, and a woman striking him with a staff
decans.signifies: drunkenness, fornication, wrath, violence, and strife

decans.image: a man armed with a coat of male, and holding a naked sword in his hand
decans.signifies: boldness, malice, and liberty

decans.image: a woman weeping, and covered with cloathes
decans.signifies: sadness and fear of his own body

decans.image: a man like in colour to gold, or an idle man playing with a staff
decans.signifies: following our own wills, and obstinacy in them, and activeness for evil things, contentions, and horrible matters

decans.image: a woman, and a man carrying full bags
decans.signifies: to go forth and to rejoyce, to gain and to lose with weakness and baseness

decans.image: two women, and a man looking towards a Bird flying in the Air
decans.signifies: requiring those things which cannot be done, and searching after those things which cannot be known

decans.image: a woman chast in body, and wise in her work, and a banker gathering his mony together on the table
decans.signifies: to govern in prudence, in covetousness of money, and in avarice

decans.image: a prudent man, and of a woman spinning
decans.signifies: thought and labour for gain, in poverty and baseness

decans.image: a man with a long beard
decans.signifies: the understanding, meeknes, modesty, liberty and good maners

decans.image: a black and angry man
decans.signifies: insolence; and impudence

decans.image: a man carrying burthens on his shoulder, and well cloathed
decans.signifies: journeys, change of place, and carefulness of getting wealth and cloaths

decans.image: a woman of a good countenance, and well adorned
decans.signifies: to desire and put ones self on about high and great matters

decans.image: a man naked, or a youth, and nigh him a beautiful maide, whose head is adorned with flowers
decans.signifies: rest, idleness, delight, fornication, and imbracings of women
